fix: keep the source erasable and run the packed check on npm 12 (#969)

* fix: keep the source erasable so it type-checks with erasableSyntaxOnly

Replace the DATA_LENGTH enum with a const object, the only non-erasable
syntax in src. Upgrade TypeScript to 5.9 and enable erasableSyntaxOnly in
tsconfig.json so yarn types rejects enums, namespaces and parameter
properties from now on. The generated declarations are unchanged by the
TypeScript upgrade.

* ci: read the packed file list from the tarball itself

npm 12 changed the shape of `npm pack --json`, so the packed check could
no longer find its manifest. Pack without --json, locate the single tarball
in the empty destination directory, extract it and walk the extracted files.
The check now asserts on what the tarball contains instead of on npm's
output
